description: Turn one client's deposits into a plain-text statement to paste into an email: every movement in date order and the closing balance held. Pass currency when they have more than one. Also a .txt download link valid one hour. Free on every tier.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed as the statement date. Defaults to today

client.description: Client id, exact name or a name containing this text

currency.description: Only needed when the client has deposits in more than one currency

greeting.description: Opening line, default "Hello" plus the client name

sign_off.description: Closing line, default your business name from the shared profile

name: deposit_statement_text
title: Plain-text deposit statement
